args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $asset=(Resolve-Path '.\dist\native-verify-rev22\miniapp-frida-native-17.3.2-abi1-windows-amd64.zip').Path; $archiveHash=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $asset).Hash; $root=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('miniapp-native-prepare-rev22-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); $cache=Join-Path $root 'cache'; $destination=Join-Path $root 'destination'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $cache,$destination | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $asset -Destination (Join-Path $cache (Split-Path -Leaf $asset)); & .\scripts\native-prepare.ps1 -Offline -CacheDirectory $cache -DestinationDirectory $destination -ExpectedArchiveSHA256 $archiveHash; $manifest=Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $destination 'manifest.json') | ConvertFrom-Json; $installedHash=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath (Join-Path $destination 'miniapp-frida.dll')).Hash; if ($installedHash -cne ([string]$manifest.sha256).ToUpperInvariant()) { throw 'offline installed DLL hash mismatch' }; Write-Output 'offline_prepare=passed'; Write-Output ('archive_sha256='+$archiveHash); Write-Output ('dll_sha256='+$installedHash)
